findings.message: Knock retard up to 1.50 deg in 8 samples, identical on all cylinders and off boost; looks like a global timing pull rather than one cylinder knocking.
No wide-open-throttle pull (peak pedal 30%). Full-load checks need a WOT pull to be meaningful.
